# @mission-platform/vite-plugin-token-overrides

Reusable Vite plugin that auto-generates an app's design-token *override*
stylesheet. It is the extraction of the former per-app
`scripts/generate-token-overrides.ts` build step into a shared, installable
plugin so any app can re-skin the design system.

## What it does

- Input: a DTCG-style override document `*.tokens.json` — a nested tree of
  `{ $value, $description? }` leaves grouped by category (`color`, `radius`,
  `shadow`, `font`, …). `$`-prefixed keys are DTCG metadata and are ignored.
- Transform: flattens each leaf to a `--<prefix>-<path-joined-by-dashes>` custom
  property. A `{ light, dark }` `$value` becomes `light-dark(<light>, <dark>)`;
  any other scalar is emitted verbatim.
- Output: a single `:root { … }` SCSS partial written to `outFile`. Import that
  generated file from your stylesheet *after* `@mission-platform/tokens` so the
  overrides win the cascade.
- No manual generate script: generation runs in the rollup `buildStart` hook
  (covering `vite build`, `vite build --watch`, and dev-server start) and
  re-runs when the source document changes in dev. The generated file is a build
  artefact — gitignore/prettierignore it rather than committing it.

## Why generate a file (not a virtual module)

CSS `@import` statements are resolved by `postcss-import`, which reads the target
from the filesystem and never reaches a Vite plugin's `resolveId`/`load` hooks —
so a virtual module cannot be pulled in through a stylesheet `@import`. Emitting a
real file (the same approach `@mission-platform/vite-plugin-tokens` uses) is what
lets `styles.css` import the overrides by path.

## API

`tokenOverridesPlugin(options): Plugin`

Options (`TokenOverridesPluginOptions`):
- `source: string` (required) — path to the override `*.tokens.json`, relative to
  the Vite root (or absolute).
- `outFile?: string` — where to write the generated SCSS partial. Defaults to the
  `source` path with its `.tokens.json` (or `.json`) extension swapped for
  `.generated.scss`.
- `prefix?: string` — custom-property prefix. Default `mp`.
- `header?: string` — leading comment for the generated partial.

Also exported (from `./transform`, re-exported at the package root):
- `buildTokenOverrideScss(document, options?): string`
- `flattenOverrides(document, prefix?): FlatOverride[]`
- types `OverrideGroup`, `OverrideToken`, `OverrideValue`, `LightDarkValue`,
  `FlatOverride`, `TokenOverrideScssOptions`.

## Consumers

- `apps/service-monitor` — registers the plugin in `vite.config.ts` with
  `source: 'design-tokens/overrides.tokens.json'`; `src/app/styles.css` imports
  the generated `../../design-tokens/overrides.generated.scss` after
  `@mission-platform/tokens`.
- `@mission-platform/mcp-shared` re-exports the transform helpers from this
  package (via `/transform`) for the consumer MCP `generate_token_override` tool.
